source_text: For HIV, randomized controlled trials demonstrate a 60% reduction in acquisition risk during heterosexual exposure in high-prevalence regions, attributable to removal of the foreskin's inner mucosal layer, which harbors HIV target cells like Langerhans cells and serves as an entry portal during microtears.
